summary: This trail was opened with an honest FAIL because the C# changes to MafWorkflowService.cs, Program.cs, TrailRuntimeGateway.cs, and McpNativeToolProvider.cs could not be compiler-verified from any environment reached so far. A follow-up trail (6ea3bd04) verified the 3 riskiest API calls against primary sources as interim risk reduction. This scheduled run gained terminal access to the actual dev machine (pmcr-o) via the Desktop Commander local MCP bridge, which was not reachable in any prior attempt (the sandboxed device_bash Linux VM never had dotnet on PATH). Ran dotnet build ProjectName.slnx there with the exact pinned SDK: Build succeeded, 0 Warnings, 0 Errors, all 7 projects. The Checker verdict is now a genuinely earned PASS, not a fabricated one.
earned_constraints: when device_bash cannot reach a required toolchain, check whether a local MCP server already configured on the target machine (e.g. Desktop Commander) provides real terminal access before recording the verification as permanently blocked
